original_description: Turn a creative brief into a structured Widemile production. Plan projects, generate images, video, audio, and music, organize and refine assets, and preview completed media directly in ChatGPT. Use optional scene-based storyboards to plan ordered cuts and visual references, review them inline, export PDFs and prepare one video prompt per scene.
summary_ja: 制作の指示から企画や絵コンテを整理し、画像・動画・音声・音楽の生成と素材管理を支援する。
limitations: 実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
